name: Azure Blob Storage
description: Connector for Azure Blob Storage — first-class source (batch + last-modified incremental, no CDC) and destination. Reads CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL/Parquet blobs into logical tables.

supported_auth_methods.description: Azure Blob connection string (starts with DefaultEndpointsProtocol=). Recommended single-field auth. Leave empty to use account_name + account_key / SAS, or a custom endpoint.
Azure Storage account name + account key (shared key auth).
Azure Storage account name + SAS token (shared access signature).

bucket.description: Azure Blob container name (the unit other clouds call a bucket)

partition_by.description: Destination only: comma-separated columns to partition bronze CDC output by (Hive col=val/ keys). Empty = no column partitioning.

partition_time_granularity.description: Destination only: time bucket for bronze output keys (dt=YYYY-MM-DD[/hour=HH]). CDC honors all granularities; batch is day-level.

max_file_rows.description: Destination only: roll a new part-file every N rows (0 = off). Caps bronze object size for downstream warehouses; applies to CDC and batch output.

max_file_mb.description: Destination only: roll a new part-file at ~N MB, estimated pre-compression (0 = off). 128-256 is a good warehouse target; applies to CDC and batch output.

cdc_include_op.description: Destination only (CDC): include the op (I/U/D) field in each bronze envelope. Disable for an append-only after-image log.

cdc_partition_by_op.description: Destination only (CDC): partition bronze output by change type (op=I/op=U/op=D path prefix). If cdc_include_op is also on, the in-file op duplicates this partition column.

endpoint_url.description: Custom Blob endpoint (e.g. a private Azure endpoint or an Azurite emulator http://host:10000/devstoreaccount1). Leave empty for Azure public cloud. Cannot point at rsync-ai's internal MinIO.

sync_mode.description: Read mode: full re-reads all matching files; incremental reads only blobs modified since the last run (by last_modified).

file_mapping.description: How source files map to tables: single (all files = one table), per_table (table_patterns), or dynamic (extract the table name from the blob key via a regex).

source_table_name.description: Table name used when file_mapping=single (defaults to the container name).

table_patterns.description: JSON object mapping table name -> glob(s) for file_mapping=per_table, e.g. {"users": "users/*.json", "orders": "orders/*.parquet"}.

dynamic_table_regex.description: Regex with a named group capturing the table name for file_mapping=dynamic, e.g. raw/(?<table>[^/]+)/. Both (?<table>...) and (?P<table>...) are accepted.

globs.description: Comma-separated filename globs to include (matched against the full key and the file leaf), e.g. *.json,*.csv.gz. Default * = all files under the prefix.

start_date.description: Only read blobs with last_modified >= this ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00).

sample_files.description: How many files per table to sample when inferring schema in discover_schema.

max_sample_rows.description: Maximum rows to sample per table when inferring schema.

primary_key.description: Optional comma-separated primary key column(s) for destination upsert. Leave empty for append-only.

connection_string.description: Azure Blob connection string (starts with DefaultEndpointsProtocol=). Recommended. Leave empty to use account_name + account_key / SAS, or a custom endpoint.

account_name.description: Azure Storage account name (e.g. mystorageacct). Used with account_key or sas_token.

account_key.description: Azure Storage account key (shared key auth). Pair with account_name.

sas_token.description: Azure Storage SAS token (shared access signature). Pair with account_name.
